stop.description: [release] stop the section now when no claim is left (what other sections need stays up)

agent.description: [claim|release] the agent claiming; defaults to the caller's agent_id

project.description: [touch] with no target: only the sections of this project; [nrepl] only this project's routes

recreate.description: [restart] recreate the containers (up --force-recreate --no-deps) instead of restarting them in place

path.description: [nrepl] a file or directory: answers the shared nREPL that drives it

wait.description: [up|switch] wait until the started services are healthy

env.description: [up|switch|restart] extra environment for compose interpolation, e.g. {"HOST_GATEWAY_IP": "192.168.1.5"}; a value {"pass": "<store path>"} is read from pass when the containers are created, and shown only as pass:<path>

no_deps.description: [up|switch] start only the named services, not their depends_on (which must already run)

target.description: [up|switch|down|stop|restart|touch|ps|logs] services or native profiles: name, project/name, or a,b

allow_shared.description: [up|switch|restart] recreate a service another live section holds (refused by default, naming the holder section and its agents)

allow_orphans.description: [up|switch|restart] go ahead although processes a dead docker daemon left running still hold the section's volumes or ports (refused by default, naming them)

description: docker compose sections for local development. Name a TARGET (a service or native compose profile of a configured compose project, e.g. target=sisf-web, target=sisf/frontend, target=sisf-web,sisf-crm) and exactly that runs, closed over the YAML's depends_on; the section's id is <project>/<targets>. Presets from compose-profiles.edn work via profile=ID. A section also starts the host PROGRAMS its project pairs with its services (a shadow-cljs watch, a JVM): a Clojure directory starts with its nREPL, and up/status answer the port. A section keeps alive everything its services depend on, so releasing or reaping another section never stops a dependency this one needs; down/stop name what they kept and why. restart recycles the named services in place (recreate=true recreates them) even when another section needs them, but never recreates (restart recreate=true, or up with other compose files, dir or env) a service another live section holds unless allow_shared=true; the refusal names that section and the agents owning it. up/switch take no_deps (start only the named services, e.g. past a failing migration), wait (until healthy) and env. touch with no target resets every active section. SWARM: an agent working on an app claims its section (claim target=.. note=..; renew within the claim TTL, release when done) and gets the shared nREPL per module to drive instead of starting its own JVM; nrepl path=<file> answers which port drives that file. The reaper keeps a section while it is claimed, agents work in its project or new nREPL connections reach it, and stops it when nobody does: after its TTL, or the shorter orphan TTL once its last claim ended. command=help lists every command with its params.

command-help.status: active sections: services, idle time, reaper countdown, host programs
command-help.targets: what each configured project offers as a target: services and native profiles
command-help.programs: host programs each project declares, how each starts, whether its nREPL answers
command-help.up: start a section alongside the others; refused while processes of a dead docker daemon hold its volumes or ports. target|profile; no_deps (only the named services), wait (until healthy), env {VAR value | VAR {"pass": path}}, allow_orphans (go ahead anyway); refused when another live section holds a service it would recreate (other compose files, dir or env), naming the section and its agents, unless allow_shared
command-help.switch: make a section current, stopping what only the previous one needed. same params as up
command-help.down: remove a section's containers (never volumes), keeping what other sections need; :kept names those and :note says when nothing was removed. target|profile
command-help.stop: stop a section's containers, keeping what other sections need; :kept names those and :note says when nothing was stopped. target|profile
command-help.restart: restart a section's services in place even when other sections need them; recreate=true recreates the containers (never their depends_on), refused when another live section holds one of them unless allow_shared. target|profile; env; allow_orphans; allow_shared
command-help.touch: reset the idle clock. target|profile for one section; none for every active one; project to narrow
command-help.ps: what a section needs and which of it runs. target|profile
command-help.logs: last log lines of a section. target|profile; tail
command-help.claim: an agent declares it works on a section, bringing it up when not active; the answer names the shared nREPL per module to drive. target|profile; agent (default agent_id); note. Renew before claim TTL
command-help.release: an agent gives up its claim; with no claim left the section is reaped after the orphan TTL, or now with stop=true. target|profile; agent; stop
command-help.who: per active section: claims, what the last pass saw using it (claims, agents working in its project, new nREPL connections), when it is reaped; per live agent the sections it works in
command-help.nrepl: which shared nREPL drives a module: path (a file or dir) for the closest one, project to filter, none for all; each with advice
command-help.reap: run the idle reaper now (usage pass, then reap)
command-help.adopt: take charge of running containers no section owns
command-help.projects: every compose project on the host
